items.a: Yes. The free account gives you 2 AI-generated applications (CV summary + cover letter) per month, plus PDF export, job search and application overview. Pro costs 109 SEK/month or 999 SEK/year and gives unlimited applications.

items.q: How does the AI tailoring work?
items.a: CVzume reads the job ad and compares it with your profile. The AI picks out requirements and keywords and writes a CV summary and cover letter that highlight your real experience. You can always edit the text before sending.

items.q: My Swedish isn't great — will it still work?
items.a: Yes, that's exactly why CVzume exists. Describe your experience simply and the AI writes the application in correct, professional Swedish. Always read the text through to make sure everything is right.

items.q: Does the AI make up experience?
items.a: No, it is instructed to use only what's in your profile. Still, always check the text — you are responsible for your application being truthful.

Your profile and applications are stored in the EU. Text to be analyzed is sent to our AI provider for processing. You can delete your account and all data at any time under Settings. Read more in the privacy policy.
Yes. There is no lock-in period, and you keep Pro until the end of the period you've paid for. You cancel yourself under Settings → Plan.

languageItem.q: Can I apply in a language that isn't my own?
languageItem.a: Yes. Describe your experience simply and choose the language for your application — English, Swedish, German, Spanish or Turkish — and the AI writes correct, professional text. Always read it through before sending.
